name: Иллюзия
alt: Крошечная мышь проецирует над собой огромного иллюзорного дракона.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink outlines, loose watercolor and gouache on warm parchment, colorful accents. One obvious visual joke, simple chunky shapes, minimal background, centered large subject with comfortable margins. Modest detail, no intricate scenery. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Clear anatomy, no extra limbs. Subject: A tiny timid pink dungeon mouse projects the enormous translucent silhouette of a fierce dragon above itself using one little crystal orb. The projection is clearly a glowing fantasy illusion, comic difference in size.
